title: Sleepy deer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='80' width='5' height='12' rx='2.5' fill='#a86b34'/>
  <rect x='43' y='82' width='5' height='10' rx='2.5' fill='#a86b34'/>
  <rect x='54' y='82' width='5' height='10' rx='2.5' fill='#a86b34'/>
  <rect x='63' y='80' width='5' height='12' rx='2.5' fill='#a86b34'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='48' width='12' height='18' rx='5' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#e0a05c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='36' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#d18f4e' transform='rotate(-25 35 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='36' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#d18f4e' transform='rotate(25 65 36)'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f7d3b0' transform='rotate(-25 35 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f7d3b0' transform='rotate(25 65 36)'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M42 31 L38 20 L33 17 M38 20 L38 13 M42 31 L40 22' stroke='#f0c894' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 31 L62 20 L67 17 M62 20 L62 13 M58 31 L60 22' stroke='#f0c894' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sleepy closed eyes -->
  <path d='M43 42 Q46 45 49 42' stroke='#5a3211' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M51 42 Q54 45 57 42' stroke='#5a3211' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f7d3b0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#7a4a1f'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 50 L50 52 M50 52 Q47 54 45.5 52 M50 52 Q53 54 54.5 52' stroke='#7a4a1f' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f2a6a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f2a6a0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='70' r='4' fill='#f7d3b0'/>
</svg>
